question: MPLO is related to RUQT in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, ILHK is related to NQMP. To which of the following options is FIEH related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/986e954f85720dd91befe36b31120df9fb83f728d6842f3b0c554810aa367f8c.png] 

Logic followed here is,

Logic: Every letter is increased by 5.

Given,

MPLO is related to RUQT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0fab0d09a2075282464c2facf39b28cee3df554ca97c0d8418584dd34e26d8fa.png] 

For, ILHK is related to NQMP.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cdb76d24c4da536fd7c49ee6f6b4b838789a572d88faf65b745e8659c1ddd51f.png] 

Similarly for FIEH is related to KNJM.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87dc1588b336f7947319dfa74f399416e4ab094e5edbccb19c89e522e38f9ced.png] 

Hence the correct answer is **"Option 3"**
